options.name: --all
options.description: Show all compiler options

options.name: --generateTrace
options.description: Generates an event trace and a list of types

options.name: --help
options.description: Gives local information for help on the CLI

options.name: --init
options.description: Initializes a TypeScript project and creates a tsconfig.json file

options.name: --listFilesOnly
options.description: Print names of files that are part of the compilation and then stop processing

options.name: --locale
options.description: Set the language of the messaging from TypeScript. This does not affect emit

options.name: --project
options.description: Compile the project given the path to its configuration file, or to a folder with a tsconfig.json

options.name: --showConfig
options.description: Print the final configuration instead of building

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the compiler's version

options.name: --build
options.description: Build one or more projects and their dependencies, if out of date

options.name: --clean
options.description: Delete the outputs of all projects

options.name: --dry
options.description: Show what would be built (or deleted, if specified with '--clean')

options.name: --force
options.description: Build all projects, including those that appear to be up to date

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose logging

options.name: --excludeDirectories
options.description: Remove a list of directories from the watch process

options.name: --excludeFiles
options.description: Remove a list of files from the watch mode's processing

options.name: --fallbackPolling
options.description: Specify what approach the watcher should use if the system runs out of native file watchers

options.name: --synchronousWatchDirectory
options.description: Synchronously call callbacks and update the state of directory watchers on platforms that don`t support recursive watching natively

options.name: --watch
options.description: Watch input files

options.name: --watchDirectory
options.description: Specify how directories are watched on systems that lack recursive file-watching functionality

options.name: --watchFile
options.description: Specify how the TypeScript watch mode works

options.name: --allowJs
options.description: Allow JavaScript files to be a part of your program. Use the checkJS option to get errors from these files

options.name: --allowSyntheticDefaultImports
options.description: Allow 'import x from y' when a module doesn't have a default export

options.name: --allowUmdGlobalAccess
options.description: Allow accessing UMD globals from modules

options.name: --allowUnreachableCode
options.description: Disable error reporting for unreachable code

options.name: --allowUnusedLabels
options.description: Disable error reporting for unused label

options.name: --alwaysStrict
options.description: Ensure 'use strict' is always emitted

options.name: --assumeChangesOnlyAffectDirectDependencies
options.description: Have recompiles in projects that use incremental and watch mode assume that changes within a file will only affect files directly depending on it

options.name: --baseUrl
options.description: Specify the base directory to resolve non-relative module names

options.name: --checkJs
options.description: Enable error reporting in type-checked JavaScript files

options.name: --composite
options.description: Enable constraints that allow a TypeScript project to be used with project references

options.name: --declaration
options.description: Generate .d.ts files from TypeScript and JavaScript files in your project

options.name: --declarationDir
options.description: Specify the output directory for generated declaration files

options.name: --declarationMap
options.description: Create sourcemaps for d.ts files

options.name: --diagnostics
options.description: Output compiler performance information after building

options.name: --disableReferencedProjectLoad
options.description: Reduce the number of projects loaded automatically by TypeScript

options.name: --disableSizeLimit
options.description: Remove the 20mb cap on total source code size for JavaScript files in the TypeScript language server

options.name: --disableSolutionSearching
options.description: Opt a project out of multi-project reference checking when editing

options.name: --disableSourceOfProjectReferenceRedirect
options.description: Disable preferring source files instead of declaration files when referencing composite projects

options.name: --downlevelIteration
options.description: Emit more compliant, but verbose and less performant JavaScript for iteration

options.name: --emitBOM
options.description: Emit a UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) in the beginning of output files

options.name: --emitDeclarationOnly
options.description: Only output d.ts files and not JavaScript files

options.name: --emitDecoratorMetadata
options.description: Emit design-type metadata for decorated declarations in source files

options.name: --esModuleInterop
options.description: Emit additional JavaScript to ease support for importing CommonJS modules. This enables allowSyntheticDefaultImports for type compatibility

options.name: --exactOptionalPropertyTypes
options.description: Differentiate between undefined and not present when type checking

options.name: --experimentalDecorators
options.description: Enable experimental support for TC39 stage 2 draft decorators

options.name: --explainFiles
options.description: Print files read during the compilation including why it was included

options.name: --extendedDiagnostics
options.description: Output more detailed compiler performance information after building

options.name: --forceConsistentCasingInFileNames
options.description: Ensure that casing is correct in imports

options.name: --generateCpuProfile
options.description: Emit a v8 CPU profile of the compiler run for debugging

options.name: --importHelpers
options.description: Allow importing helper functions from tslib once per project, instead of including them per-file

options.name: --importsNotUsedAsValues
options.description: Specify emit/checking behavior for imports that are only used for types

options.name: --incremental
options.description: Save .tsbuildinfo files to allow for incremental compilation of projects

options.name: --inlineSourceMap
options.description: Include sourcemap files inside the emitted JavaScript

options.name: --inlineSources
options.description: Include source code in the sourcemaps inside the emitted JavaScript

options.name: --isolatedModules
options.description: Ensure that each file can be safely transpiled without relying on other imports

options.name: --jsx
options.description: Specify what JSX code is generated

options.name: --jsxFactory
options.description: Specify the JSX factory function used when targeting React JSX emit, e.g. 'React.createElement' or 'h'

options.name: --jsxFragmentFactory
options.description: Specify the JSX Fragment reference used for fragments when targeting React JSX emit e.g. 'React.Fragment' or 'Fragment'

options.name: --jsxImportSource
options.description: Specify module specifier used to import the JSX factory functions when using jsx: react-jsx*

options.name: --keyofStringsOnly
options.description: Make keyof only return strings instead of string, numbers or symbols. Legacy option

options.name: --lib
options.description: Specify a set of bundled library declaration files that describe the target runtime environment

options.name: --listEmittedFiles
options.description: Print the names of emitted files after a compilation

options.name: --listFiles
options.description: Print all of the files read during the compilation

options.name: --mapRoot
options.description: Specify the location where debugger should locate map files instead of generated locations

options.name: --maxNodeModuleJsDepth
options.description: Specify the maximum folder depth used for checking JavaScript files from node_modules. Only applicable with allowJs

options.name: --module
options.description: Specify what module code is generated

options.name: --moduleResolution
options.description: Specify how TypeScript looks up a file from a given module specifier

options.name: --newLine
options.description: Set the newline character for emitting files

options.name: --noEmit
options.description: Disable emitting file from a compilation

options.name: --noEmitHelpers
options.description: Disable generating custom helper functions like __extends in compiled output

options.name: --noEmitOnError
options.description: Disable emitting files if any type checking errors are reported

options.name: --noErrorTruncation
options.description: Disable truncating types in error messages

options.name: --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch
options.description: Enable error reporting for fallthrough cases in switch statements

options.name: --noImplicitAny
options.description: Enable error reporting for expressions and declarations with an implied any type

options.name: --noImplicitOverride
options.description: Ensure overriding members in derived classes are marked with an override modifier

options.name: --noImplicitReturns
options.description: Enable error reporting for codepaths that do not explicitly return in a function

options.name: --noImplicitThis
options.description: Enable error reporting when this is given the type any

options.name: --noImplicitUseStrict
options.description: Disable adding 'use strict' directives in emitted JavaScript files

options.name: --noLib
options.description: Disable including any library files, including the default lib.d.ts

options.name: --noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature
options.description: Enforces using indexed accessors for keys declared using an indexed type

options.name: --noResolve
options.description: Disallow imports, requires or <reference>s from expanding the number of files TypeScript should add to a project

options.name: --noStrictGenericChecks
options.description: Disable strict checking of generic signatures in function types

options.name: --noUncheckedIndexedAccess
options.description: Add undefined to a type when accessed using an index

options.name: --noUnusedLocals
options.description: Enable error reporting when a local variables aren't read

options.name: --noUnusedParameters
options.description: Raise an error when a function parameter isn't read

options.name: --outDir
options.description: Specify an output folder for all emitted files

options.name: --outFile
options.description: Specify a file that bundles all outputs into one JavaScript file. If declaration is true, also designates a file that bundles all .d.ts output

options.name: --paths
options.description: Specify a set of entries that re-map imports to additional lookup locations

options.name: --plugins
options.description: Specify a list of language service plugins to include

options.name: --preserveConstEnums
options.description: Disable erasing const enum declarations in generated code

options.name: --preserveSymlinks
options.description: Disable resolving symlinks to their realpath. This correlates to the same flag in node

options.name: --preserveWatchOutput
options.description: Disable wiping the console in watch mode

options.name: --pretty
options.description: Enable color and formatting in output to make compiler errors easier to read

options.name: --reactNamespace
options.description: Specify the object invoked for createElement. This only applies when targeting react JSX emit

options.name: --removeComments
options.description: Disable emitting comments

options.name: --resolveJsonModule
options.description: Enable importing .json files

options.name: --rootDir
options.description: Specify the root folder within your source files

options.name: --rootDirs
options.description: Allow multiple folders to be treated as one when resolving modules

options.name: --skipDefaultLibCheck
options.description: Skip type checking .d.ts files that are included with TypeScript

options.name: --skipLibCheck
options.description: Skip type checking all .d.ts files

options.name: --sourceMap
options.description: Create source map files for emitted JavaScript files

options.name: --sourceRoot
options.description: Specify the root path for debuggers to find the reference source code

options.name: --strict
options.description: Enable all strict type checking options

options.name: --strictBindCallApply
options.description: Check that the arguments for bind, call, and apply methods match the original function

options.name: --strictFunctionTypes
options.description: When assigning functions, check to ensure parameters and the return values are subtype-compatible

options.name: --strictNullChecks
options.description: When type checking, take into account null and undefined

options.name: --strictPropertyInitialization
options.description: Check for class properties that are declared but not set in the constructor

options.name: --stripInternal
options.description: Disable emitting declarations that have @internal in their JSDoc comments

options.name: --suppressExcessPropertyErrors
options.description: Disable reporting of excess property errors during the creation of object literals

options.name: --suppressImplicitAnyIndexErrors
options.description: Suppress noImplicitAny errors when indexing objects that lack index signatures

options.name: --target
options.description: Set the JavaScript language version for emitted JavaScript and include compatible library declarations

options.name: --traceResolution
options.description: Log paths used during the moduleResolution process

options.name: --tsBuildInfoFile
options.description: Specify the folder for .tsbuildinfo incremental compilation files

options.name: --typeRoots
options.description: Specify multiple folders that act like ./node_modules/@types

options.name: --types
options.description: Specify type package names to be included without being referenced in a source file

options.name: --useDefineForClassFields
options.description: Emit ECMAScript-standard-compliant class fields

options.name: --useUnknownInCatchVariables
options.description: Default catch clause variables as unknown instead of any
